entities.name: PMID:25432081
observations: Randomized multicountry phase 2 study of pazopanib eye drops versus ranibizumab intravitreal injections in 510 subjects with neovascular AMD.
At week 52, pazopanib eye drops with as-needed ranibizumab were noninferior for BCVA maintenance but did not reduce as-needed ranibizumab injections by at least 50%.
Authors concluded daily pazopanib eye drops provided no therapeutic benefit beyond ranibizumab alone.

entities.name: NCT01134055
observations: Completed randomized, quadruple-masked, parallel phase 2 dose-ranging trial; actual enrollment 510.
Compared multiple pazopanib eye-drop regimens, placebo eye drops with as-needed ranibizumab, and ranibizumab intravitreal injection every 4 weeks.
Official title specifies pazopanib eye drops versus ranibizumab intravitreal injections for neovascular AMD.

entities.name: Pazopanib
observations: Topical ophthalmic pazopanib was clinically evaluated in neovascular AMD as an alternative/add-on strategy to intravitreal anti-VEGF treatment.

entities.name: Ranibizumab
observations: Ranibizumab was used as a monthly intravitreal active comparator and as-needed rescue treatment in eye-drop groups.
